query:
-- Generate reset tokens for both test accounts
UPDATE users 
SET resetToken = HEX(RANDOM_BYTES(32)), 
    resetTokenExpiry = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
WHERE email IN ('tim.monacella@pcbancard.com', 'drteam@pcbancard.com');

-- Retrieve the reset tokens
SELECT id, email, resetToken, resetTokenExpiry 
FROM users 
WHERE email IN ('tim.monacella@pcbancard.com', 'drteam@pcbancard.com');
